what_it_does: Two mana 1/1. Every artifact creature you control gets +1/+1. Drawn too late? Pay WB and discard it to deal 2 damage to a creature and gain 2 life.
best_home: Any artifact creature deck. Thopters, Servos, Myr, Borg tokens — all of them get bigger.
take: A lord when you need a lord and a removal spell when you don't. That's rare on a two-drop.

more.take: One mana 2/1. Every artifact creature you control gets vigilance.
Four mana, and all your artifact creatures have double strike. With Locutus out that gets silly.
Three mana. Every nontoken artifact that enters makes a 1/1 Borg. At six quest counters it makes two.

question: Would you build the Borg artifact deck, or is it too linear?
